schema.text: How many adults (aged 18 or older), including yourself, live in your home?

de.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Wie viele Erwachsene (ab 18 Jahren), Sie selbst eingeschlossen, leben in Ihrem Haushalt?

tr.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Siz dahil, evinizde kaç yetişkin (18 yaş ve üzeri) yaşıyor?

fa.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: چند بزرگسال (18 سال یا بیشتر)، از جمله خودتان، در خانه شما زندگی می‌کنند؟

hu.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Hány felnőtt (18 éves vagy idősebb) él az otthonában, Önt is beleértve?
